chitchat: drags another belt of shells over to the gun and spits.
"Nobody paid us for the sky. We just don't like things flying over the works."
description: A Slagworks powder hand hauling belts of shells out of a scorched ready-locker, face wrapped against the smoke off the slag.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Slagworks powder hand
